# IT Infrastructure Migration Plan Template

## Purpose
To provide a structured, comprehensive framework for planning and executing IT infrastructure migrations, including strategy definition, risk assessment, and phased implementation tracking.

## When to Use This Template
- Planning a major infrastructure migration (cloud, data center, technology platform)
- Need to coordinate complex, phased migration activities across systems
- Risk management and stakeholder communication are critical
- Building organizational confidence in migration approach
- Creating accountability across technical teams and sponsors

## Overview
A standardized template for planning and executing infrastructure migrations in IT environments. This template helps teams define migration strategy, assess and mitigate risks, and establish detailed implementation plans with clear timelines and responsibilities.

## Usage
Complete each section sequentially before and during your migration. Use the template to:
1. Define and communicate your migration approach to stakeholders
2. Proactively identify and plan for infrastructure risks
3. Break down migration work into phases with clear milestones
4. Track progress and manage dependencies across teams

## Executive Summary

## Migration Strategy
[Define migration approach and methodology]

## Risk Assessment
[Identify and plan for migration risks]

## When NOT to Use

Do not use for very low-risk, short-duration tasks where informal risk awareness is sufficient. Avoid this template if your governance framework requires a different risk management approach or if stakeholders prefer real-time risk dashboards over static registers.

## Implementation Plan
[Detailed migration steps and timeline]
